Manutention des amarres

The operation of preparing, passing, securing, and tending mooring lines to assist in berthing or unberthing a vessel.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Manutention des amarres?

In this glossary, Manutention des amarres refers to: The operation of preparing, passing, securing, and tending mooring lines to assist in berthing or unberthing a vessel.

How is Manutention des amarres used in maritime?

In maritime communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Poste avant, préparez-vous à la manutention des amarres ; passez l'amarre d'étrave à quai dès que possible."

Why does Manutention des amarres matter in maritime?

Manutention des amarres matters because it supports clear communication in External Communication contexts for Deck Officers, Engine Officers, and Masters. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as STCW, Marlins Test, ISF Watchkeeper, and GMDSS.

Who uses Manutention des amarres?

Manutention des amarres is mainly used by Deck Officers, Engine Officers, and Masters.

What category does Manutention des amarres belong to?

In this glossary, Manutention des amarres is grouped under External Communication. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from IMO SMCP, STCW Convention, SOLAS, COLREG and published by Protermify Maritime as a static maritime reference page.

Definition

The operation of preparing, passing, securing, and tending mooring lines to assist in berthing or unberthing a vessel.

Operational example

Forward station, prepare for line handling; pass head line ashore as soon as we are within heaving distance.

Localized term
